fact_text: Raast is a back-end instant payment switch, not an account, app or card; it was introduced in 2019 as a central bank initiative and settles transfers in real time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Card payments reached merchants two to four days after a sale because settlement ran through the international card networks, and merchants recovered that cost through a charge of about 2% on the sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Every participating bank and fintech is connected to the Raast switch, so one shared rail lets any two accounts in the system pay each other without a separate bilateral link.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: The newer ISO messaging standard used by Raast can carry rich data with a payment, such as billing detail, images and transaction context, rather than only an amount and account number.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: A utility bill paid through the system can carry twelve months of usage history and tax details, so the payment message records the context of the bill as well as its amount.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Pakistan has roughly 60 to 65 million payment cards in the market, mostly debit, with credit cards a small fraction, issued by banks under Visa and Mastercard standards.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: The prime minister's office set a target of taking Raast to 2 million merchants by June 2026, and the banking industry is working toward that goal, the Raast CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Raast had onboarded roughly 1.3 to 1.4 million merchants at the time of the interview, short of the 2 million merchant target.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: About 50 million Raast IDs, which link a mobile number to a bank account so money can be sent to the number, had been loaded into the system at the time of the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: According to the Raast CEO, the system handles about one trillion in transaction volume every seven days, and that volume keeps growing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Raast daily transaction counts run into the millions and rise sharply on salary days, when many payroll transfers are processed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Government-to-person and government-to-vendor payments, including salaries, pensions, vendor contracts and fees paid by citizens, make up the largest segment of payments, the Raast CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: The government has provided subsidies to banks and fintechs that offer digital payment services, so they can put the incentive into marketing, training and merchant onboarding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Over roughly 2023 to mid-2026, most shopkeepers in major cities and tier-two towns came to have a wallet able to receive payments, which the interviewee read as a behaviour shift toward digital payments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Offline payments let two devices in close proximity record a transaction without internet, then settle both accounts with priority once either device reconnects, using a tokenised account record.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Under the Direct Non-Settlement Participant programme, a fintech can connect directly to the payment system and test a use case without first going through a partner bank, a Raast representative said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Digitised order and payment records between a merchant and its distributor let a fintech judge the merchant's spending capacity and offer inventory finance covering 10 to 15 days of stock.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Digital fraud rises with digitisation; most cases involve customers sharing their data or a code after a misunderstanding or in return for an incentive, a Raast representative said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: A limited survey by Karandaaz and a research partner in district towns and tier-two and tier-three cities found knowledge gaps led merchants' concerns about digital payments, with tax worries probably third or fourth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: A significant part of the economy operates under the radar, and the Raast CEO said digital payments are not meant to target tax collection, which is one reason some merchants keep using cash.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Merchants and consumers worry that a payment may fail when the internet drops mid-transaction, and the Raast CEO said consistent completion remains a trust barrier to adoption.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Banks hold marketing budgets that could be directed to build awareness of digital payments, which the Raast CEO said banks had not fully used, although a collaborative effort is under way.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Karandaaz describes itself as a development finance institution that brings financial products to segments such as SMEs and MSMEs where conventional banking has not reached, and works on consumer awareness.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)

fact_text: Raast transfers cost the customer and the merchant nothing and settle in real time, because the government built the rail as a public good; card rails are run by two international companies outside Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Raast and Karandaaz Are Reshaping Pakistan's Financial System | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-15)
